title: Senior Frontier Agents Engineer (Applied AI)
location_text: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
description:
About Scale AI 
Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

The Opportunity 
Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Senior Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI) , you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems that combine frontier models with structured knowledge, retrieval, traditional machine learning, and enterprise software.

Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on a single model or product, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of AI challenges spanning multiple industries and use cases. You may build a multi-agent research system and then participate in designing a customer intelligence platform, a healthcare copilot, or an autonomous workflow for a Fortune 100 company.

If you enjoy reading new AI papers, experimenting with the latest models, and shipping production systems that create measurable business impact, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Build 
Frontier AI Systems 

• Design and deploy production AI agents that leverage the latest advances in large language models, reasoning, retrieval, memory, and tool use.

• Architect intelligent systems that combine LLMs, traditional machine learning, structured knowledge, enterprise data, and deterministic software into reliable production workflows.

• Engineer customer intelligence layers, retrieval pipelines, memory systems, and knowledge representations that allow agents to reason over large, heterogeneous enterprise data.

• Develop multi-agent systems that coordinate reasoning, planning, tool execution, and human oversight.

• Translate frontier AI research into production systems by rapidly evaluating new models, prompting techniques, reasoning paradigms, and agent architectures.

Experimentation & Evaluation 

• Own the full experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis generation to production rollout.

• Design rigorous evaluation frameworks using offline benchmarks, online A/B experiments, golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-a-Judge, and human evaluation.

• Run controlled experiments and ablation studies to understand the contribution of different models, prompts, retrieval strategies, reasoning techniques, memory systems, and agent architectures.

• Continuously evaluate newly released frontier models and determine where they meaningfully improve quality, latency, reliability, or cost.

• Develop confidence estimation, reflection, and continuous learning systems that improve agents over time using real-world feedback.

• Measure success through business outcomes, not benchmark scores.

Production AI Engineering 

• Build production-quality AI systems with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, latency, safety, and cost.

• Design agent guardrails, fallback strategies, tracing, monitoring, and evaluation pipelines that enable safe deployment in high-stakes environments.

• Collaborate with infrastructure engineers to deploy AI systems securely within enterprise cloud environments.

• Build human-in-the-loop workflows that effectively combine AI automation with expert oversight.

Customer Innovation 

• Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their business, data, and operational challenges.

• Translate ambiguous customer problems into production AI architectures.

• Rapidly prototype new ideas, validate them with customers, and evolve successful solutions into scalable production systems.

• Identify reusable patterns that become core capabilities across many enterprise deployments.

What Makes This Role Different 
You'll work across the full lifecycle of modern AI systems:

• Designing reasoning and agent architectures

• Building retrieval, memory, and customer intelligence systems

• Developing predictive models that work alongside LLMs

• Running experiments and ablation studies

• Shipping production systems into enterprise environments

• Measuring business impact through online experimentation

• Continuously improving agents using real-world feedback

We believe the fastest way to grow as an Frontier Agents engineer is to solve many different AI problems, not the same problem repeatedly. You'll work across diverse industries, datasets, model architectures, and agentic systems, rapidly developing intuition for what makes AI systems successful in production.

Required Qualifications 

• 5+ years of software engineering, machine learning, or applied AI experience.

• Strong Python programming skills.

• Experience building production AI systems using LLMs.

• Experience with modern AI tooling, including OpenAI, Claude, MCP, agent frameworks, vector databases, or retrieval systems.

• Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals and modern language models.

• Experience designing or evaluating AI systems using quantitative metrics.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications 
Applied AI 

• Experience building production AI agents or autonomous systems.

• Deep understanding of reasoning, retrieval, memory, planning, and tool use.

• Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agentic systems.

• Experience with RAG, semantic search, knowledge graphs, customer intelligence systems, or structured knowledge representations.

• Experience with fine-tuning, distillation, reinforcement learning, small language models, or model optimization.

• Familiarity with multimodal AI systems and frontier foundation models.

Software Engineering 

• Experience building distributed production systems.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability.

• Experience integrating AI systems into enterprise software environments.

Customer Engineering 

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers.

• Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical architectures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience leading technical workshops, architecture reviews, or customer design sessions.

Dual Fluency 
While this role initially emphasizes Applied AI and machine learning, every Frontier Agent Engineer develops expertise across both Applied AI and Forward Deployed Engineering.

Over time, you'll gain hands-on experience integrating AI systems into enterprise environments, deploying production infrastructure, and working directly with customer engineering teams. Our goal is to develop engineers who can move seamlessly between cutting-edge AI research and real-world production systems.

Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

• 3+ years managing product design teams

title: Staff Frontier Agents Engineer (Applied AI)
location_text: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
description:
About Scale AI 
Scale AI is the data foundation for AI, helping organizations build and deploy reliable production AI applications. We partner with the world's leading enterprises and government organizations to accelerate their AI transformation through frontier AI systems that solve real business problems.

Every day, we work with organizations across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, media and telecommunications to build production AI agents that automate complex workflows, help humans, reason over enterprise knowledge, and operate safely at scale.

The Opportunity 
Applied AI is moving faster than ever. New foundation models, reasoning techniques, agent architectures, and research papers emerge every week. Yet building AI systems that reliably solve real-world problems remains one of the hardest engineering challenges.

As a Staff Frontier Agent Engineer (Applied AI) , you'll bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production deployment. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems that combine frontier models with structured knowledge, retrieval, traditional machine learning, and enterprise software.

Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on a single model or product, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of AI challenges spanning multiple industries and use cases. You may build a multi-agent research system and then participate in designing a customer intelligence platform, a healthcare copilot, or an autonomous workflow for a Fortune 100 company.

If you enjoy reading new AI papers, experimenting with the latest models, and shipping production systems that create measurable business impact, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Build 
Frontier AI Systems 

• Design and deploy production AI agents that leverage the latest advances in large language models, reasoning, retrieval, memory, and tool use.

• Architect intelligent systems that combine LLMs, traditional machine learning, structured knowledge, enterprise data, and deterministic software into reliable production workflows.

• Engineer customer intelligence layers, retrieval pipelines, memory systems, and knowledge representations that allow agents to reason over large, heterogeneous enterprise data.

• Develop multi-agent systems that coordinate reasoning, planning, tool execution, and human oversight.

• Translate frontier AI research into production systems by rapidly evaluating new models, prompting techniques, reasoning paradigms, and agent architectures.

Experimentation & Evaluation 

• Own the full experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis generation to production rollout.

• Design rigorous evaluation frameworks using offline benchmarks, online A/B experiments, golden datasets, regression suites, LLM-as-a-Judge, and human evaluation.

• Run controlled experiments and ablation studies to understand the contribution of different models, prompts, retrieval strategies, reasoning techniques, memory systems, and agent architectures.

• Continuously evaluate newly released frontier models and determine where they meaningfully improve quality, latency, reliability, or cost.

• Develop confidence estimation, reflection, and continuous learning systems that improve agents over time using real-world feedback.

• Measure success through business outcomes, not benchmark scores.

Production AI Engineering 

• Build production-quality AI systems with a strong emphasis on reliability, observability, latency, safety, and cost.

• Design agent guardrails, fallback strategies, tracing, monitoring, and evaluation pipelines that enable safe deployment in high-stakes environments.

• Collaborate with infrastructure engineers to deploy AI systems securely within enterprise cloud environments.

• Build human-in-the-loop workflows that effectively combine AI automation with expert oversight.

Customer Innovation 

• Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their business, data, and operational challenges.

• Translate ambiguous customer problems into production AI architectures.

• Rapidly prototype new ideas, validate them with customers, and evolve successful solutions into scalable production systems.

• Identify reusable patterns that become core capabilities across many enterprise deployments.

What Makes This Role Different 
You'll work across the full lifecycle of modern AI systems:

• Designing reasoning and agent architectures

• Building retrieval, memory, and customer intelligence systems

• Developing predictive models that work alongside LLMs

• Running experiments and ablation studies

• Shipping production systems into enterprise environments

• Measuring business impact through online experimentation

• Continuously improving agents using real-world feedback

We believe the fastest way to grow as an Frontier Agents engineer is to solve many different AI problems, not the same problem repeatedly. You'll work across diverse industries, datasets, model architectures, and agentic systems, rapidly developing intuition for what makes AI systems successful in production.

Required Qualifications 

• 8+ years of software engineering, machine learning, or applied AI experience.

• Strong Python programming skills.

• Experience building production AI systems using LLMs.

• Experience with modern AI tooling, including OpenAI, Claude, MCP, agent frameworks, vector databases, or retrieval systems.

• Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals and modern language models.

• Experience designing or evaluating AI systems using quantitative metrics.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications 
Applied AI 

• Experience building production AI agents or autonomous systems.

• Deep understanding of reasoning, retrieval, memory, planning, and tool use.

• Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agentic systems.

• Experience with RAG, semantic search, knowledge graphs, customer intelligence systems, or structured knowledge representations.

• Experience with fine-tuning, distillation, reinforcement learning, small language models, or model optimization.

• Familiarity with multimodal AI systems and frontier foundation models.

Software Engineering 

• Experience building distributed production systems.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability.

• Experience integrating AI systems into enterprise software environments.

Customer Engineering 

• Experience working directly with enterprise customers.

• Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical architectures.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience leading technical workshops, architecture reviews, or customer design sessions.

Dual Fluency 
While this role initially emphasizes Applied AI and machine learning, every Frontier Agent Engineer develops expertise across both Applied AI and Forward Deployed Engineering.

Over time, you'll gain hands-on experience integrating AI systems into enterprise environments, deploying production infrastructure, and working directly with customer engineering teams. Our goal is to develop engineers who can move seamlessly between cutting-edge AI research and real-world production systems.

description:
Role Summary 
The Support Team Manager is responsible for the day-to-day leadership and performance of a team of Support Specialists, serving as the primary connection between frontline agents and broader operational leadership. This role balances hands-on people management with operational oversight, including but not limited to coaching team members, driving performance outcomes, managing escalations, and ensuring contributors receive consistent, high-quality support experiences.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
🚀 About Us 
We’re Bolt.new by StackBlitz!

We’re the team that brought you WebContainers, the first-of-its-kind technology that made it possible to run Node.js right inside your browser. That breakthrough kicked off our journey in 2019, and it’s what powers the blazing-fast online IDE used by over 1 million developers every month.

But we didn’t stop there. We doubled down on everything we learned and built Bolt.new — the fastest way to go from idea to production without writing traditional code. It’s a next-gen, AI-powered app builder that helps you create, edit, and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps instantly, right in your browser. No installs. No setup. Just smart automation and instant dev environments that let you move at the speed of thought.

We’re a fully remote team, globally distributed, deeply collaborative, and seriously passionate about building the future of software development.

This is your chance to join a small team with a big vision. If you love shipping fast, solving real problems, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, we’d love to meet you.

✨ About This Opportunity 
It’s an exciting time to join the Bolt design team. The company is in its hyper-growth phase, and design has a major role to play in taking Bolt.new to the next level, not just in look and feel, but in product quality, building the iconic product experiences this AI moment calls for.

We’re building an elite team, and we’re growing. You’ll get hands-on experience leading design on everything from the smallest details to the biggest bets. We have plenty of ambiguous problems to solve and we move fast. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and hungry builders. Expectations are high, and so are the impacts.

As a Staff Product Designer, you’ll lead design for new zero-to-one product experiences in untapped territory. You’re comfortable with the discomfort of not knowing, and energized by challenging how things have always been done, coming up with solutions that don’t just improve, but evolve, how individuals and teams use AI. You’re someone who can fly at 1,000 feet and 3 inches above the ground at the same time: someone who can drive strategy using a designer’s superpower, while still obsessing over the details that actually make a difference.

🛠️ How You'll Contribute 

• Understand your customers: Are they asking for a faster horse, or a car? Work with cross-functional partners to identify and prioritize the user problems worth solving, not just the ones people have today, but the ones that will make their lives easier tomorrow. Think big!

• Own projects end to end: From partnering with product on problem definition, through divergent and convergent design thinking, to tangible designs (in Figma or with AI tools), design QA, and quality control.

• Set the vision for what future Bolt looks like: We’re in a fast-evolving industry, and we need to think fast and act boldly, not follow trends, but define how teams use AI to build great products. Use tangible designs to drive product directions. After all, designers have the superpower to turn abstract ideas into something people can see and react to.

• Raise the quality bar on all things design: Typography, spacing, motion, and visual consistency. Build and improve our design systems to result in higher-quality product launches across a growing product line.

💡 Qualifications 

• A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional crafts

• A track record of shipping pixel-perfect work at scale in a fast-paced environment

• Comfort operating in ambiguous, zero-to-one environments while holding a high craft bar under deadline pressure

• Fluency in design systems, and the discipline to build for consistency across a growing platform

• Experience partnering closely with engineering to protect visual fidelity through implementation

• You’re already using AI to tackle personal and professional challenges

• Strong verbal and written English communication skills are required, as this role involves frequent collaboration with team members, stakeholders, and customers where English is the primary working language.

🎯 Bonus Points 

• Startup or small team experience. You are not just one of many!

• Experience in shaping AI tools

📌 A Few Notes 

• 
You do not need a college degree to apply

• 
You do not need to be located in the U.S. — we’re remote-friendly

• 
You do not need to meet every qualification listed above

description:

About the job 

We're hiring a Marketing Strategy & Analytics Manager to join our global marketing analytics team, sitting alongside our Media Mix Modeling (MMM) data scientists and our regional analytics business partners (EMEA and APJ). This is a hybrid role: part senior business partner, part data scientist. You'll act as a trusted analytics advisor to marketing leadership — owning end-to-end analyses of funnel performance, campaign effectiveness, and marketing ROI — while also being fluent enough in MMM methodology to apply, extend, and translate our MMM outputs into decisions our regional and global marketing leaders can act on.

Own end-to-end analytics across B2B and B2C marketing funnels, from data pull through insight to executive-ready recommendation.

• MMM Team Partnership: Partner closely with the central MMM data science team to ensure model assumptions, inputs, and outputs reflect real business context, and to prioritize the roadmap of modeling questions that matter most to the business.

• Tooling & Scale: Write production-quality Python/SQL for data pulls, analysis, and light modeling; build reusable tools and dashboards that scale insight generation across the team.

• Storytelling & Communication: Craft and deliver clear, compelling narratives and presentations for senior stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Finance.

• Cross-Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional analytics business partners (EMEA, APJ) to ensure consistency.

About the job 

Twilio’s Internal Communications team is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Principal Internal Communications Manager to serve as a cornerstone of our global IC function. In this role, you will act as a primary thought partner to the team lead on overarching program strategy and execution, while taking direct ownership of our most critical, sensitive, and high-stakes employee communications. Your work will be integral to protecting Twilio's culture, aligning our workforce, and navigating complex corporate moments for our 5,500 Twilions around the world.

This Twilion will have world-class strategic acumen, impeccable discretion, and a calm, steady demeanor under pressure. You are a seasoned expert at navigating complex corporate, legal, and social environments, possessing the rare ability to translate high-stakes business realities into empathetic, clear, and highly effective internal narratives.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll:

• Partner on Global IC Strategy: Work in close partnership with the Internal Communications Lead to co-architect the overarching strategic direction and execution of the wider internal communications program.

• Partner closely with PR/External Comms: Serve as point of contact with external comms team during strategic projects and crises, ensuring internal and external narratives stay aligned and sequenced.

• Lead highly sensitive employee communications: Own the end-to-end strategy, narrative creation, and execution for high-stakes, sensitive corporate scenarios, ensuring absolute confidentiality, accuracy, and cultural alignment. Including but not limited to employment legal issues, ethics and misconduct cases, regulatory or legal actions, and safety & security incidents.

• Manage transactional & structural change comms: Drive the internal communication strategy for complex corporate evolutions, including Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), strategic transactions, organizational redesigns, and executive transitions

• Advise on social Issues: Provide strategic counsel and develop thoughtful framework-driven messaging regarding complex external political and social issues, balancing company values with employee sentiment.

• Collaborate cross functionally: Partner deeply with Legal, HR, Employee Relations, Security, and Corporate Affairs to operationalize communications around sensitive matters, ensuring a unified, legally compliant, and compassionate voice.

• Support finance communications: Partner with the Finance org and ghostwrite for the CFO on both companywide financial moments (earnings, financial updates) and the CFO's internal comms to the finance org, including quarterly updates and finance org all hands.

• Flex across the IC portfolio: When there isn’t an active strategic project or crisis, plug into the broader work of the team (Q&A prep, All Hands support, comms campaigns, etc.) and whatever else needs a strong writer and thinker.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

• In-Role experience: 10+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, or crisis management, with a proven track record operating at a principal or senior manager level within a global technology company.

• Strategic partnership and execution: Demonstrated experience acting as a trusted right-hand to communications leadership, helping to steer broader program strategy while simultaneously executing on the ground.

• Crisis & sensitive comms expertise: Deep, hands-on experience managing highly confidential and sensitive communications, particularly around M&A, restructuring, legal actions, and complex workplace issues.

• Executive presence and discretion: Exceptional emotional intelligence, commanding poise under pressure, and the ability to interface with and influence C-suite executives and legal counsel on highly sensitive matters.

• Project management: Very comfortable moving between strategic and tactical work, holding multiple projects to deadline, managing stakeholders, keeping partners informed, etc. Strong operational muscle to complement the strategic and creative work.

• Ghostwriting range: Proven ability to write in the voice of a variety of leaders, often for people you don’t work with daily and with limited advance notice. Quick study on tone, cadence, and point of view.

title: Account Executive, Commercial
description:
About Vercel: 
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. 

About the Role: 
Vercel's sales team is built on people who are technically fluent, commercially sharp, and deeply curious about the companies they sell into.

You’ll run full-cycle deals in close partnership with Solutions Architects, Marketing, and Customer Success, and you’ll help shape how Vercel goes to market as we continue to expand our Commercial segment. We’re building a team with a strong preference to grow talent internally. If you want a path to larger scopes and leadership over time, this is a great place to do it.

This is a high-impact, net-new logo role on a fast-growing, technical sales team. You’ll sell to developers and engineering leaders at modern, digital-native companies, connecting Vercel’s front-end cloud and developer experience to measurable business outcomes (speed, conversion, productivity, reliability).

You’ll be at the leading edge of modern web and AI, working with customers who build and ship fast. You’ll collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to help teams adopt Vercel and expand their impact as they scale.

Our team is based out of our London office three days a week - and soon, we'll be moving into our brand-new space in King's Cross. Come be part of building what's next!

What You Will Do: 

• Own a net-new revenue number by building and progressing pipeline from first meeting through close

• Build pipeline in partnership with your BDR and generate your own outbound pipeline through prospecting, multi-threading, and thoughtful account research

Presentations are one of the highest-leverage surfaces at Vercel. This role will own the full lifecycle of presentation design, from initial concept through storytelling, visual design, presentation systems, and final delivery across PowerPoint, Figma, Keynote, and Google Slides.

They may also partner with our Design Engineering team to explore and build internal tools that make it easier for teams to create high-quality, on-brand decks efficiently.

You'll work closely with our Creative/Brand, Executive, Product Marketing, Communications, Events, and Design Engineering teams to turn complex technical concepts into visual narratives that resonate with any audience and raise the bar for presentation design across the company.

This role is ideal for a designer who thinks about narrative and hierarchy as much as pixels, can balance high-touch creative work with scalable systems thinking, and knows how to build trust while working directly with senior executives under tight timelines. You'll report to the Director of Creative Design within our Creative/Brand team and will be based in San Francisco or New York City.

• Iterate quickly on feedback from executives and cross-functional partners, delivering polished, presentation-ready materials under deadline pressure.

• Support Vercel's highest-visibility moments, including product launches, corporate events, customer presentations, and executive keynotes, with design that performs on the main stage.

• Strong understanding of presentation systems, including templates, reusable components, master layouts, documentation, and asset governance.

description:
At Webflow, we're building the world's leading Agentic Marketing Experience Platform, and we're doing it as a remote-first company built on trust, transparency, and a whole lot of creativity. This work takes grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. Our mission is to bring development superpowers to everyone. From entrepreneurs launching their first idea to global enterprises scaling their digital presence, we empower teams to design, launch, and optimize for the web without barriers. We believe the future of the web, and work, is more open, more creative, and more equitable. And we're here to build it together.

About the Role 
We are looking for a backend-leaning Senior Software Engineer who is energized by distributed systems, cares about reliability as a feature, and wants to own infrastructure rather than hand it off to join to the Covert team, here you will build the systems that tell Webflow customers what to fix on their site, and then the agentic workflows that go fix it for them: technical and content recommendations, Forms, our AI workflow platform, and the agent builder customers use to compose and run their own agentic workflows. We're a product engineering team that owns its own infrastructure, and that surface keeps growing as we scale an agentic recommendations platform that does real work on customers' behalf. You will help us move from systems that react to failure toward systems that are resilient to it.

• Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

• Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

• Application Information:

• Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

• Own and harden the infrastructure our products run on, including our AI workflow platform on AWS and Kubernetes: improving reliability, observability, and scalability, not just consuming infra built elsewhere.

• Strengthen how our systems handle failure: eventing and streaming, retries, backpressure, and recovery, so a single outage doesn't turn into days of replay.

• Reduce single points of failure across our infrastructure and share operational and on-call ownership, so no critical system depends on any one person.

• Design clean service and API boundaries, and write and optimize the MongoDB data models and queries that power recommendations.

• Leverage state-of-the-art AI tooling to increase your impact, and help the team build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic, LLM-backed components.

• Partner with product engineers, PMs, and designers to ship end-to-end, and raise the bar on tested, observable, maintainable code and thoughtful design docs.

• Mentor engineers across the team on backend and reliability practices as we shift the team's center of gravity toward distributed systems.

• BA/BS degree or equivalent experience

• Business-level fluency to read, write and speak in English

• Have 5+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, ideally in scalable, multi-tenant SaaS.

• Have real depth in distributed systems: concurrency, asynchronous and eventually-consistent processing, queues or streaming, and designing for failure rather than assuming the happy path.

• Are strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable modeling data in MongoDB or a comparable database.

• Are hands-on with cloud infrastructure and DevOps: AWS, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability (metrics, logging, tracing). You're happy owning infra and improving it.

• Experience with workflow or orchestration engines (n8n, Temporal, Airflow, or similar).

We're looking for a Staff Brand Designer who works in the space between brand and web—someone who can hold a brand idea and build it themselves. Our marketing site is where most people meet Webflow, which makes it the primary surface of our brand rather than a place we put finished work. You'll design that experience and take it all the way into production on our own platform. The brand doesn't stop at the site, though—it shows up in campaigns, conference environments, film, and the product itself—and you'll work across those surfaces too. The border between those disciplines is disappearing in practice: a conference identity now ships as a motion system and a site in the same breath, and an announcement has to hold in a keynote and a viewport in the same week. This role also sits closest to the edge of what's newly possible, so we care most about someone who is already experimenting—putting AI and agentic tooling to real use and bringing back what holds up. You'll sit on Brand Studio, Webflow's in-house creative team, as a senior individual contributor working alongside brand designers, motion, and marketing partners.

About the role: 

• Location: Remote-first (United States; BC & ON, Canada)

• Full-time

• Permanent

• Exempt

• The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

• United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)

• Zone C: $ 143,300 - $172,000

• 177,000 - 213,000 

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals. 

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

• Application Information:

• This posting is for an existing vacancy

As a Staff Brand Designer, you'll…

Design the web as our primary brand surface 

• Treat webflow.com as the place most people meet the brand, and design it as an experience rather than a stack of sections.

• Shape pacing, narrative, and flow across a visitor's path, not just the layout of individual pages.

• Express the brand through behavior—type, motion, interaction, and state—not only through how a frame looks at rest.

• Extend the brand system into web-native patterns and components that other designers and marketers can use without you in the room.

Work in the space between brand and web 

• Design and build in the same motion, carrying work from brand idea to shipped page without handing it off at the seam.

• Act as the primary technical owner of Webflow's marketing surface area, from CMS architecture to component systems to publishing workflow.

• Build on Webflow as our most sophisticated customer, so the site stands as proof of what the platform can do rather than an exception to it.

• Hold the craft bar on brand expression and the technical bar on implementation at the same time, and know when the two are in tension.

• Make architectural calls that balance ambition against performance, scalability, and the cost of maintaining them a year from now.

• Ship launches, campaign pages, and fixes with speed and accuracy under real deadline pressure, including moments like Webflow Conf, and own performance, accessibility, and SEO health as ongoing commitments.

Work across the brand's other surfaces 

• Bring the same standard to work that isn't a website: campaign systems, conference environments, editorial, film, and the brand's expression inside the product.

• Design for coherence across surfaces, so an idea that starts on the site still holds up in a keynote, a video, or a physical space.

• Understand how a brand system has to behave differently in each medium, and help evolve the system itself rather than only its web expression.

Experiment, and put what works into production 

• Work in the open with AI-assisted design and development, generative code, and agentic build tooling, and bring back what actually holds up under a quality bar.

• Explore advanced and pre-release platform capabilities and ship them ahead of the market.

• Build the experiments that make an argument—a working prototype that settles a debate faster than a deck would.

• Use generative and agentic tooling where it closes the gap between designing a system and building it, which is increasingly the same act.

• Develop the team's practice as you go, so a tool you proved out this month is something everyone is using next month.

• Feed real practitioner insight back to Product and Engineering, because you're building on the thing we sell.

Unblock the business 

• Partner with Brand Studio, Product Marketing, Growth, Legal, and Events to get campaigns and launches live without compromising the site.

• Reduce dependency bottlenecks by making your expertise available early, when decisions are still cheap to change.

• Mentor designers and marketers through pairing, feedback, and the systems and guardrails you build for them.

• Translate technical constraints into plain language so non-technical partners can make good tradeoffs themselves.

In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, at Webflow we will support you in identifying where your interests and development opportunities lie and we'll help you incorporate them into your role. 

About you: 
Requirements:

• BS/BA college degree or relevant experience

• 8+ years of experience spanning brand design and web design or development, with work that clearly shows both

• Demonstrated experience designing marketing websites as a primary surface of a brand—narrative, flow, and interaction across a journey, not just individual page layouts

• Deep, demonstrable Webflow expertise, including complex CMS structures, components, interactions, performance work, and system-level thinking

• Experience contributing to brand work beyond websites—campaigns, environments, editorial, motion, or product surfaces—with a view on how a brand system has to change shape in each

• Active AI fluency: you are already using AI and agentic tooling in real production work, and can show what you have built with it, what you have thrown away, and how you tell those apart

• Familiarity with code: you read HTML and CSS comfortably, can follow and adapt JavaScript, and are not stuck when a build needs to go past the visual editor. Professional development experience is not required.

• A portfolio that shows both identity-level craft and shipped, high-traffic sites you can speak to at the architecture level

title: Account Associate
description:
About Wolt 
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

At Wolt, you can grow your career with a fun and fast-scaling global business. Part of the DoorDash team, we’re building a global logistics platform that can deliver (almost) everything in your city, to your door in minutes. Today, our products are used by 55+ million registered users who can now order from 200,000+ restaurants and retail stores across 30+ countries around the world.

Our Onboarding teams create and build our relationships with merchants. Together, we’ve helped big brands, local stores and neighborhood restaurants do over €15 billion’s worth of business through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career. 

What you’ll be doing 
Day-to-day in this role you’ll: 

• Onboard venues into Wolt's platform - booking and uploading photos, uploading menus to set guides, menu and profile translations, training and restaurant/retail support.

• Ensuring Restaurant and Retail Partner profiles on the platform are up to date and to support them on a day-to-day basis together with Support Associates.

• Proactively search for knowledge cross functions when needed.

• Follow-up on personal and team KPIs for lead time and onboarding volume.

• Work together with Development Managers to optimize Restaurant and Retail Partner performance.

Our humble expectations 

• Being able to carry the duties and responsibilities of the role listed above.

• Have a self-starter mindset and willingness to contribute to hands-on activities in a flat organisation.

• Contribute to structure and have an eye for details.

• Be able to collaborate and proactively communicate clearly both verbally and in written form with various stakeholders, English and Norwegian.

• Be able to prioritise Wolt culture and values as the fundamental elements of Wolt growing as a successful business.

• Most importantly, be part of the team! As a team, we do common things uncommonly well.

Our offer: 

• Cashback credits on Wolt shopping

• Training and career opportunities

• Employee assistance program 

Why you’ll love it 

• 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

• 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills 

• 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

• 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps 
Things move fast around here. So, if you’re excited about taking your first step with Wolt, apply today! 💙

title: Courier HR Senior Specialist
description:
About Wolt 
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.

The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.

We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.

About the role 
Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.

As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters. 

You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.

What you'll be doing 
Employee lifecycle execution at scale 

• Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).

• Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.

• Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.

• Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.

• Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.

Process and SOP creation 

• Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process & Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.

• Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.

• Partner with the Process & Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.

Cross-functional coordination 

• Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.

• Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.

• Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.

Our humble expectations 
There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:

• 3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.

• Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.

• A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.

• High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.

• Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.

• Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.

• Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).

What we offer 
Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.

If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you. 

Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September. 

Additional benefits: 

• Health insurance

• A sport benefit (PassSport)

• A tax-free commuter benefit

• A monthly lunch benefit

• Wolt Credits Cashback program

• Access to the Employee Assistance Program (free, confidential mental health support) and the Cuckoo wellness app

As a Senior Account Manager, you’ll be the primary point of contact for a number of large enterprise accounts. You’ll work across multiple layers of each organisation – from central decision-makers to regional managers and local stores – with a focus on long-term growth and operational excellence.

You’ll plan and execute advanced promotional campaigns, lead commercial negotiations, and use data to optimize every aspect of partner performance. In addition to managing your portfolio, you’ll help shape internal tooling and best practices that support the broader enterprise AM community.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll: 

• Own a small but commercially significant portfolio of restaurant enterprise accounts end-to-end

• Lead negotiations and strategic planning in collaboration with senior internal and external stakeholders

• Drive adoption of relevant Wolt products such as Wolt+, Wolt Ads, Wolt Drive, and Wolt Capital

• Analyse partner performance in depth – from conversion rates to delivery efficiency – and turn insights into concrete actions

• Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Product to ensure smooth execution of partner plans and bring feedback from the field into internal roadmaps

• Build tools, frameworks, or workflows that support smarter decision-making within your team and across the region

• Tailor your approach to different organisational layers, from headquarters to local store operators

Our humble expectations 
We’re looking for someone who combines commercial sharpness, analytical depth, and strong interpersonal skills – and who’s motivated by solving complex challenges.

• Strategic commercial thinking – You understand what drives partner performance and profitability, and you can develop win-win plans that balance long-term growth with short-term impact

• Advanced analytical skills – You’re highly comfortable navigating BI tools like Looker or Excel, building your own performance views, and using data to guide negotiations, campaigns, and optimisations

• Ownership mindset – You take full responsibility for your portfolio, push projects forward without being asked, and proactively solve problems when roadblocks appear

• Process builder – You enjoy improving how things work – whether through creating internal tooling, building a new report, or refining the way we engage with partners

• Experience – You likely have 3+ years in account management, strategy, consulting, or commercial roles with enterprise exposure

• Languages – You’re fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

What we offer 
At Wolt, we believe great people thrive when given ownership, trust, and the chance to make an impact. As a Senior Account Manager, you’ll get exactly that – along with a competitive salary and the opportunity to grow in a fast-moving global tech company with plenty of career paths.

description:

Wolt is a Finnish technology company on a mission to make cities better places to live by empowering local commerce. Since 2014, we've grown from food delivery in Helsinki into a platform spanning groceries, retail, and more, operating in 30+ countries and 800+ cities together with DoorDash. Wolt Market is our own grocery concept, bringing everyday essentials to customers' doors in minutes, and our Wolt Market business in Germany is growing fast. We're looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to help keep our stores stocked, our operations efficient, and our customers happy.

What you’ll be doing 
As a Supply Chain Analyst, you'll be the person who keeps our Wolt Market stores in Germany running smoothly behind the scenes, making sure the right products are on the shelf at the right time. You'll dig into data to spot trends and risks early, and work closely with store operations, category management, and central supply chain teams to keep availability high and waste low.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll: 

• Monitor and analyze inventory levels, stock availability, and replenishment across our Wolt Market dark stores in Germany, flagging risks before they become problems 

• Build and maintain demand forecasts to guide ordering decisions, working closely with store teams and category managers to balance availability against waste 

• Identify and troubleshoot supply chain bottlenecks, from supplier delays to warehouse capacity issues, and drive process improvements to fix them 

• Build reports and dashboards that give visibility into key supply chain KPIs, such as stock-outs, waste, and on-time delivery, and share insights with stakeholders across the business 

Our humble expectations 
We don't expect you to tick every box below, but we think you'll thrive in this role if you have most of the following:

• 1-3 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, retail operations, or a similarly analytical role, ideally in grocery, e-commerce, or quick commerce 

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills,

• A structured, data-driven approach to problem solving, with the ability to turn numbers into clear recommendations 

• Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken, to work effectively with local teams, suppliers, and stores across Germany 

Nice to haves: 

• Experience with WMS/ERP systems, demand forecasting tools, or a background in FMCG/grocery supply chain is a big plus, though not required 

• Solid grasp of SQL or similar tools to pull and analyze your own data 

• Comfortable using AI tools and prompting to work smarter, automate repetitive tasks, and get the most out of AI in your day-to-day work

What we offer 
Joining Wolt Market Germany means real ownership over an area that directly shapes what thousands of customers see on their doorstep every day. You'll work alongside sharp, supportive colleagues across Germany and the wider Wolt/DoorDash organization, with plenty of room to grow as our Wolt Market business scales. On top of that, expect a competitive salary, employee discounts on Wolt orders, and the flexibility and trust of a company that still moves like a startup.
